text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks C and E at losses and later rebought E at a higher price; before trading, I should write down a clear reason and what would change my mind.","I added to Stocks A and B, so I should check each holding’s share of my portfolio and avoid letting any one stock dominate my risk.","My account value fluctuated over these months; I should judge decisions against a steady ten-year apartment goal, not chase quick gains or react to short-term moves."]}
